title: CloudFlare Pages ISR Configuration for Next.js 14+
body: When deploying Next.js 14+ to CloudFlare Pages with ISR support, you need to configure the @cloudflare/next-on-pages adapter with specific edge runtime settings. The key insight is that ISR routes must use the edge runtime export, and the revalidation interval maps to CloudFlare's cache TTL — not Next.js's built-in ISR mechanism. Set `export const runtime = 'edge'` and `export const revalidate = 3600` in each ISR route. The adapter handles the rest. Common mistake: using `getStaticProps` with `revalidate` — this doesn't work on Pages because there's no Node.js runtime for on-demand revalidation. Use `generateStaticParams` + edge runtime instead.
